title: Locked car found open repeatedly; fear of car bomb
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Locked car found open repeatedly; fear of car bomb, about 1989-1990 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Yeah, and I mean, we would lock it and test the door and because it had happened before and go, "All right, It's locked.

He said, 'I was with Bob all the time and we were scared that something was going to blow up.'" And he says, "I was so going through all my hard times that I didn't care. I just told Bob, 'Stay out and I'll try it.'"
tellings.difference: Told secondhand from Mario, who says he started the car himself while Lazar stayed back.
tellings.link_reason: The same car-bomb fear around Lazar's car in Las Vegas in 1989-90, told from Mario's side.

as_told.title: Mario's account of starting Lazar's car for fear of a bomb
